title: Recovery
purpose: Verify one bounded synthetic recovery from an internal fault while preserving policy, release, candidate, and rollback identities.

entryEvidence.observation: A bounded synthetic incident record identifies an internal fault for one exact policy and release identity.
The aggregate operations projection classifies the selected synthetic application unavailable before recovery.
One retained synthetic candidate provides exact source, artifact, policy, release, checksum, and rollback identities.

boundedActions.instruction: Record the incident, policy, release, candidate, rollback, and aggregate unavailable-state identities once.
Verify the approved synthetic recovery candidate and bounded policy limits without changing retained bytes.
Prepare one exact recovery policy that preserves the selected source, release, candidate, and approved rollback identities.
Request separate approval for the exact recovery policy, candidate, and aggregate verification plan.

stopConditions.observation: Stop if any policy, release, candidate, rollback, checksum, incident, or receipt identity is absent or inconsistent.
Stop if the bounded aggregate recovery projection remains unavailable after the selected synthetic check.
Stop as ready for a recovered receipt only when the same selected policy and candidate classify the synthetic application available.

rollbackActions.instruction: Keep the last independently verified release unchanged if recovery selection or aggregate verification fails.
